# Codebase Map

**Generated by `node scripts/gen-codebase-map.mjs` — do not edit.** CI fails if this file drifts
from disk (`npm run check:map`), which is the only thing that makes a map trustworthy: a hand-maintained
map is accurate exactly until the first person forgets, and then it is worse than none.

This does not list every file. A listing is not a map. It answers the question a new agent actually
has — **what can stop me, and where does that live** — because in this repo the enforcement *is* the
architecture.

## What can block

Every file below declares its own `POSTURE:` header; this table reads that header rather than restating
it, so a hook that changes posture changes this map with it.

| File | Posture | Runs on |
|---|---|---|
| `.claude/hooks/budget-guard.js` | BLOCKS | not registered |
| `.claude/hooks/gsa-check-update.js` | ADVISES | SessionStart |
| `.claude/hooks/gsa-context-monitor.js` | ADVISES | not registered |
| `.claude/hooks/gsa-statusline.js` | ADVISES | statusLine |
| `.claude/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh` | BLOCKS | PreToolUse |
| `.claude/hooks/schema-lint.js` | BLOCKS | not registered |
| `.claude/hooks/session-start.js` | ADVISES | SessionStart |
| `.claude/hooks/stop.sh` | ADVISES | not registered |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | BLOCKS | pull_request |

## Core modules

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `scripts/lib/claims.js` | The ONE YAML parser and the closed claim schema. Do not add a second |
| `scripts/lib/classifier.js` | The ONE risk implementation. Two would disagree during the incident |
| `scripts/lib/resolvers.js` | Four resolvers. `unresolved` is never `pass` — the invariant the ledger rests on |
| `scripts/lib/usage.js` | Spend measurement from session transcripts; append-only is what makes it fast |
| `scripts/ledger.mjs` | build · rebuild · lint · verify · judge · locate · events · views · sweep |
| `scripts/check-registration.mjs` | The fabrication catcher: dead paths, drifted counts, phantom agents, NUL bytes |
| `scripts/gen-codebase-map.mjs` | This file |

## What the system asserts

40 project claims in `.claude/ledger/index.json`, plus any `scope: global` claims in
`~/.warroom/ledger/global.yml` — machine state a fresh clone does not have, which the ledger reports
rather than skipping silently.

| Kind | Count |
|---|---|
| behavior | 17 |
| external-fact | 1 |
| internal-fact | 15 |
| runtime-capability | 7 |

Browse them with `npm run ledger:views`; sweep for expiry with `npm run ledger:sweep`.

## The other three memory files

| File | Generated? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `DECISIONS.md` | **No — human, append-only** | It holds rejected options and rationale. The ledger stores `assert + evidence + expiry` and has no field for either, so a generated view would drop the only part still worth reading a year later. "Non-lossy" fails by construction, not by difficulty |
| `LONG-TERM.md` | **No — not ledger-derivable** | Founder preferences and recurring patterns. Not claims: they carry no evidence and expire on nothing |
| `USER-INSIGHTS.md` | **No — not ledger-derivable** | Customer language and JTBD, sourced from research. Empty today, and CMO is hard-gated on it |

*Phase 6 amended the gate criterion that asked for all four. The measurement that forced it is in
`DECISIONS.md` — three of the four were empty templates, and the fourth could not be one.*
